summary: Craig Horlacher, 57, of Wheat Ridge, shattered his lower leg (tibial plateau) slipping on the streambed while fishing the Middle Fork of the Little Snake River near its confluence with Tennessee Creek; spent five nights propped on rocks in the creek, found delirious about 9:20 a.m. Aug 12 by Routt County SAR, roped about 200 ft up the canyon to a Flight for Life helicopter; 15 days ICU / 33 days hospital.
location: Middle Fork of the Little Snake River, near confluence with Tennessee Creek, North Routt County
notes: INSERT run1004; date pin: left Denver Fri Aug 6, 2010; fell Sat Aug 7 (Craig Daily Press story as quoted in repost); found Thu Aug 12 ~9:20 a.m., fifth night/sixth day (5280 first-person account; Will Rice essay, The Drake Spring 2011). Craig Daily Press original URL not located, not cited.
